data.name: REVE5_001
data.value: (No wind...[pause=10] No fire,[pause=10] no mountain,[pause=10] no camp...[pause=20] Everything is gone.)

data.name: REVE5_002
data.value: (That spring...[pause=10] I know it.[pause=20] But this sky, these petals, this light...[pause=15] I'm dreaming.[pause=0] This is a dream.)

data.name: REVE5_004
data.value: (That shape...[pause=10] That voice...[pause=15] It's YOU.[pause=10] You're the one I've been hearing all along!)

data.name: REVE5_005
data.value: Do not be afraid,[pause=10] little echo.[pause=20] This place is only a reflection —[pause=10] the shape your heart lends to mine.

data.name: REVE5_006
data.value: (Who... who are you?[pause=20] How do you know me?)

data.name: REVE5_007
data.value: A friend from another time.[pause=20] That is all the dream allows me to give you.

data.name: REVE5_008
data.value: The mountain has lit up.[pause=20] Like last time.[pause=30] You have seen it burn before...[pause=20] haven't you?

data.name: REVE5_009
data.value: (Burn...?![pause=15] No...[pause=10] I...[pause=10] I don't remember anything!)

data.name: REVE5_010
data.value: Climb.[pause=20] The wind remembers you,[pause=10] even if you remember nothing.

data.name: REVE5_011
data.value: When you reach the summit...[pause=20] do not look for me.[pause=30] I will find you.

data.name: REVE5_012
data.value: (Wait![pause=20] What do you mean, "burn"?![pause=15] Tell me!)

data.name: REVE5_013
data.value: We have met before,[pause=10] little echo.[pause=25] And we will meet again.
